title: The Greatest Saints are from Palestine
body:
These people are in Masjid al-Aqsa? Mashaa-Allah. The greatest saints are there in Masjid al-Aqsa. They can
take the whole world like this and throw it from east to west. Those awliya, mashaa-Allah, have such spiritual
power, himmat. What a spiritual power! Yaa RijalAllah, O men of Allah (swt)! They are appointed to keep
the al-Aqsa Mosque.
For the sake of Your generous Prophet (s), keep an eye on the believers, the nation of the Beloved (s), on
those in the land of Palestine. Enough, inshaa-Allah. Those who will be removed from the world will be
replaced by the best of people!
Fatihah.
May Allah (swt) give an opening (of blessings) first to the people of Palestine, then to the rest of the countries.
It is coming.
I was young, five or seven years old and the people from Haifa, Jafa, Nablus, and Akka wore their traditional
dress and came here to get married. Hundreds of our (Turkish) girls married them. That is why the
Palestinians are strong, but they are ignorant like us! I love them, subhaan-Allah!

May Allah (swt) give you an opening soon. Make du`a for this poor and weak servant. Wa `alaykum salaam
wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh.
Lefke, 12.11.2011 (Translated from Arabic)
